title: Officer Wastes No Time Catching Wanted Criminal in Library
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 11, 2023, a police officer identified the suspect in a bicycle theft investigation in Kenosha, WI, who was also wanted on an active felony warrant. While on patrol, the officer happened to observe the stolen bike at a public library. Upon confronting the suspect, he made a desperate attempt to escape but the officer quickly crushed his chances, literally.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
